AIM Workshop “Pólya-Schur-Lax Problems: Hyperbolicity and Stability
Preservers” — A List of Open Problems
record.original_question:
For a real entire function φ of order at most one with only real
negative zeros, define T_k^(1)(φ(x)) = (φ^(k)(x))^2 -
φ^(k-1)(x)φ^(k+1)(x) for k ≥ 1, and recursively define T_k^(n)(φ(x)) =
(T_k^(n-1)(φ(x)))^2 - T_(k-1)^(n-1)(φ(x))
T_(k+1)^(n-1)(φ(x)) for k ≥ n ≥ 1. Are these iterated Laguerre
inequalities always nonnegative for all x ≥ 0 and all k ≥
n?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\varphi$ be a real entire function of order at most one that has only real negative zeros (so $\varphi$ belongs to the Laguerre–Pólya class with all zeros in $(-\infty,0)$). Define
\[
T_k^{(1)}(\varphi(x)) := \bigl(\varphi^{(k)}(x)\bigr)^2 - \varphi^{(k-1)}(x)\,\varphi^{(k+1)}(x), \qquad k \ge 1,
\]
and recursively, for integers $n \ge 2$ and $k \ge n$,
\[
T_k^{(n)}(\varphi(x)) := \bigl(T_k^{(n-1)}(\varphi(x))\bigr)^2 - T_{k-1}^{(n-1)}(\varphi(x))\,T_{k+1}^{(n-1)}(\varphi(x)).
\]
Prove or disprove: for every such $\varphi$, one has
\[
T_k^{(n)}(\varphi(x)) \ge 0 \quad \text{for all } x \ge 0 \text{ and all integers } k \ge n \ge 1.
\]
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is listed among open problems from an AIM workshop on Pólya–Schur–Lax problems. Related work by Craven–Csordas on iterated Laguerre and Turán inequalities establishes the inequalities in special cases and for functions in the Laguerre–Pólya class under additional hypotheses, but a full resolution for the formulation above (real entire $\varphi$ of order at most one with only real negative zeros, for all $x\ge 0$ and $k\ge n$) does not appear to have been published. No source confirming a complete proof or counterexample was located.

status_evidence.title: Iterated Laguerre and Turán Inequalities — Craven & Csordas
status_evidence.snippet: Iterated Laguerre and Turán inequalities; results for functions in the Laguerre–Pólya class.
status_evidence.claim: Related results establish iterated Laguerre inequalities in special cases but do not fully resolve the stated conjecture.

status_evidence.title: The Laguerre Inequality and the Distribution of Zeros of Entire Functions
status_evidence.snippet: Studies Laguerre-type inequalities and zero distribution for entire functions.
status_evidence.claim: Provides related necessary conditions but not a proof of the iterated inequalities for all k>=n and x>=0.
